text: {"name":"ble_tx_queue_entry_get","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns the indexed 32-byte BLE transmit-queue entry after clearing and initializing it, and faults if its byte at offset 30 was already nonzero.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"a1":"entry_index","v1":"entry_table_base","v2":"entry","v3":"entry_index_byte","v4":"entry_byte_offset"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Word copied from global dword_12AE3C."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Self-pointer to this entry."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Control or state field initialized to 3."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Entry index stored as a byte."},{"offset":30,"meaning":"Byte checked for nonzero before the entry is cleared."}]}
